primitives.note: Every ability costs 5% of Briar's current health; she has no mana pool, so casts self-damage and are limited by remaining health, not a resource bar
Crimson Curse bleed deals physical damage over 5s in 0.5s ticks, refreshing duration on reapplication
Bleed stacks up to 5 times on the target, each stack beyond the first adding 25% more tick damage; stacks are added by any basic attack, on-hit effect or ability hit
Head Rush, Blood Frenzy's dash, and Snack Attack each reset Briar's basic attack timer
Head Rush reduces the target's armor and magic resistance for 5 seconds, amplifying all subsequent damage to it
Blood Frenzy grants bonus attack speed and movement speed for 5s; Hematomania (R) grants all of Blood Frenzy's effects plus bonus armor/MR, lifesteal, and extra movement speed until the mark ends
Snack Attack arms Briar's next basic attack during Blood Frenzy with bonus physical damage and a heal
Snack Attack's bonus damage scales with the target's missing health; Certain Death's explosion damages the marked target and nearby enemies on arrival
Blood Frenzy's cleave AoE damage is affected by (and copies) the primary attack's critical strike
Chilling Scream charges for up to 1s, increasing its own damage/range/knockback threshold and granting Briar 35% damage reduction and a self-heal during the charge
Chilling Scream auto-recasts (or can be recast) to release the charged scream; Certain Death has a kick cast time, then a mark, then a separate dash-and-explosion phase

needsBespoke.why: The kit's damage-relevant mechanics (stacking bleed DOT, health-cost-as-resource, attack resets, a timed on-hit-cleave buff with an empowered-attack follow-up, a target debuff, a charge/recast ability, and a multi-part ultimate with a conditional AoE burst) each map onto one closed-list primitive. Because the fight is a single stationary target counted as an enemy champion, Briar's real-game target-priority logic (nearest enemy, marked-target priority, monster/minion tiers) collapses to 'always the dummy' and needs no bespoke targeting engine.

unsettled.question: Does Blood Frenzy's cleave AoE damage and/or Snack Attack's bonus damage count as on-hit / trigger on-attack item effects, or only the primary basic-attack instance?
options: Only the primary attack triggers on-hit/on-attack effects; the cleave and Snack Attack's bonus are pure bonus damage with no separate proc
The cleave and/or Snack Attack also independently trigger on-hit/on-attack item effects as their own attack instances
quotes: This damage is affected by {{tip|critical strike}} modifiers.

unsettled.question: Can Head Rush (Q) be freely cast while Blood Frenzy's forced-attack phase is already active without ending the Frenzy, the way it can during the initial W dash?
options: Q can be cast at any point during Blood Frenzy without interrupting it, same as during the dash
Q cast during the forced-attack phase (outside the dash) cancels/ends Blood Frenzy early
quotes: ''{{ai|Head Rush|Briar}}'' and {{ai|Certain Death|Briar}} can be cast during the dash.''

unsettled.question: Is the bleed's heal-on-target-death (125% of 'remaining bleed damage') computed from pre-mitigation or post-mitigation damage? The wiki source itself flags this as unresolved.
options: Pre-mitigation, consistent with the tick heal's stated pre-mitigation basis
Post-mitigation, since the target's actual remaining HP/damage taken would be post-mitigation
quotes: she will heal herself equal to 125% <!--pre or post mitigation?--> of the remaining bleed damage

unsettled.question: Since every ability costs 5% of Briar's current health with no mana gate, can/should repeated casting in the 15s damage fight actually reduce her toward 0 health, and should the simulator cap or stop casts to avoid self-kill?
options: Model the health cost fully; a maximal-cast rotation could meaningfully lower Briar's HP and the simulator should track it (possibly halting casts near a floor)
Treat the cost as a fixed small percentage that never meaningfully threatens Briar's survival and can be ignored for rotation planning

unsettled.question: If Head Rush's armor/MR shred is reapplied by a second Q cast before the first 5s shred expires, does it just refresh the same shred duration/magnitude, or can the percentage stack additively from multiple applications?
options: Refresh-only: reapplying just resets the 5s timer at the same shred percentage
Additive: overlapping applications stack their shred percentages
quotes: reduces their {{sti|armor penetration|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|magic penetration|{{as|magic resistance}}}} for 5 seconds

proposal: Open with Certain Death (R) if it is off cooldown, since its cast immediately grants Hematomania (all of Blood Frenzy's buffs) plus bonus resists/lifesteal/move speed and deals its own magic burst on arrival; if R is unavailable, open with Blood Frenzy (W) instead to enter the frenzy.
Immediately follow with Head Rush (Q) on the dummy for its own physical damage, stun, armor/MR shred (amplifying all later damage), on-hit/on-attack triggers, and an attack-timer reset.

Auto-attack continuously while Blood Frenzy/Hematomania is active, benefiting from the attack-speed buff and dealing the cleave AoE bonus physical damage on every attack while building bleed stacks toward the 5-stack cap.
Cast Snack Attack as soon as it is available during the frenzy window for its missing-health-scaled bonus damage and heal, without delaying the next auto-attack.
Recast Head Rush every time it comes off cooldown to reapply the shred, add another hit of Q damage, and reset the attack timer again.

Hold Chilling Scream (E) until between Blood Frenzy windows (or as a fight-ending burst), since casting it interrupts an active frenzy; charge it the full 1 second to maximize its damage and unlock the wall-collision bonus damage if geometry allows.
Recast Blood Frenzy (W) as soon as its cooldown is available to keep the attack-speed/movement-speed buff and cleave damage uptime as continuous as possible for the remainder of the 15 seconds.
